entries.reason: Temporary maintainer-approved release exception through 2026-11-20; review by this date, and remove the baseline as soon as a supported Node runtime ships OpenSSL 3.5.10+. Tracked in https://github.com/felixgeelhaar/ghostline/issues/45. Nox confirmed four OpenSSL 3.5.9 advisories in the pinned Node image; vulnerable code reachability is undetermined. This baseline records accepted interim risk and is not evidence the findings are fixed.
